Product Description

Bold definition that lasts from day to night.

Define your eyes effortlessly with our Kajal, designed to deliver rich, intense colour in a single stroke. Its ultra-smooth formula glides comfortably along the waterline and lash line, providing deep pigmentation for instantly captivating eyes.

Whether you prefer a subtle everyday look or bold, dramatic definition, this kajal offers a soft, comfortable application with long-lasting wear. Its creamy texture ensures a smooth finish while helping your eye makeup stay fresh throughout the day.
